items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: And on top of that we was playing right behind Louis Armstrong. Everywhere we was playing. Louis Armstrong was playing five or six days before we got there.

ctx.x: Cooper. Cooper. And I learned that she was around Chicago, but she left here and she went to Detroit, and I heard that she was in Chicago. Last time I was in Chicago, a fellow told me that she was playing with somebody around Chicago in a loop. And I said, I'd like to see her. I met a piano player there. And I had, his name was Bubba, I forget his name, I've been knowing him, I've been knowing him before I knew how to play. But anyhow, he said she called it. And he told me Ann was playing somewhere in the loop…
Not very many girls that played good trumpet.
